angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 911,367 km at 208.17 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.8037 +/- 0.0148 mas (same row, RUWE 0.72): 208.17 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.31 +/- 0.13 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-30 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 911,367 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.55 +/- 0.51 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-30 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6304 +/- 88 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-30 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-30 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-30.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.394, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-30 (pscomppars): spectral type F7, from Luo et al. 2018 (http://vizier.u-strasbg.fr/viz-bin/VizieR-3?-source=V/153/stellar4)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+06 1909: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-30 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.13 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-30 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.312, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-30 (pscomppars): age 1 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-30 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.2 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
